title: Desk Guidance: Installment Relief from the Promptness of a Reinstated Security Deposits Installment
content:
The reconnection multiple of the Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit assessed under Security Deposits at the reconnection of a Schedule R or Schedule FH account whose waived deposit was reinstated carries an installment relief that rewards prompt payment of the reinstated deposit.

## Guidance

The installment relief comes from how soon the reinstated deposit's first installment was paid, counted in calendar days from the reinstated deposit's assessed date to the posting date of the deposit payment on it (the latest one, where more than one has posted). A payment posted within the prompt-installment days of **10** takes the prompt installment relief of **0.5**; one posted after that but within the reinstated deposit's tier deposit due days takes the on-time installment relief of **0.25**; one posted later takes no relief. The installment relief is taken off the reconnection multiple. The reconnection multiple is never below **2.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

## Deposit due days of the reinstated deposit's tier

| Tier of the reinstated deposit | Deposit due days |
|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | 20 |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | 10 |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | 20 |
| Farm Service Deposit | 20 |
| General Service Deposit | 10 |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | 10 |

## Counting the days (hypothetical reinstated Farm Service Deposit assessed on March 2)

| Posting date of the deposit payment | Calendar days from the assessed date | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| March 12 | 10 | 0.5 |
| March 13 | 11 | 0.25 |
| March 22 | 20 | 0.25 |
| March 23 | 21 | none |

A payment posted on the assessed date itself counts as zero days. Both dates are read from the reinstated deposit's own record and its deposit ledger.
